newsitem.title: USA: US Physical Therapy to trade on Nasdaq NMS.
newsitem.headline: US Physical Therapy to trade on Nasdaq NMS.

text.p: U.S. Physical Therapy Inc said Friday that its common stock, which had been trading on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market, will begin trading on the Nasdaq National Market System effective Monday, April 28.
The company's common stock will remain USPH.

President and Chief Executive Officer Roy Spradlin said "meeting the more stringent requirements of the Nasdaq National Market reflects U.S. Physical Therapy's continued growth and financial progress."
U.S. Physical Therapy and its partners operate outpatient clinics throughout the United States.
